pub_err_auth: The connection token is no longer valid ({detail}). Publishing is paused for this platform until you reconnect it in Settings.
pub_err_permission: Meta refused the request because a permission or Page role is missing ({detail}). Add the publishing permissions and renew the token.
pub_host_missing: This post needs a media host so Meta can download the files. Set one up in Settings → Publishing.
pub_host_video_unsupported: The selected media host cannot serve videos. Use an S3-compatible bucket.
pub_s3_incomplete: The S3 media host is incomplete or invalid: {fields}.

pub_s3_delete_failed: Deleting the temporary copy from the S3 bucket failed (HTTP {status}).

pub_url_unreachable: The media file is not publicly reachable at {url} ({status}).

pub_fbpage_no_url: Facebook did not return a URL for the uploaded photo.
pub_file_missing: The media file {name} is missing on disk. Re-import it.

pub_no_remote_id: Meta did not return the id of the published post.
pub_no_media: This post has no media for the chosen format.
pub_unsupported_format: The format "{format}" cannot be published on this platform.

pub_container_timeout: Meta took more than 20 minutes to process the media.
pub_fb_video_too_large: Facebook videos over 1 GB are not supported yet. Upload a smaller file.

pub_native_not_published: Facebook did not publish the scheduled post within 24 hours of its time.
